# v1.1.0-dev.55 - Support link, clearer update failures

Small release. Nothing changes about saving, loading, or matching.

## New

Settings, then Updates, now carries an About block with a link to the
project page and a support button, and the status bar has a small "buy me
a coffee" chip. WLM stays free either way. There is no nag dialog,
nothing on first run, and no reminder that ever interrupts you.

## Fixed

- Update failures explain themselves. A dead feed or a failed download
  now names the manual download page instead of surfacing a raw socket
  error. The build is hosted off-site, so those failures are almost
  always the network in between rather than anything the app can retry
  around.
- The update dialog's button reads "Open download page". It still said
  "View on GitHub" from before dev.53 moved distribution, and pointed
  somewhere that no longer served it.
- Status bar layout. A fixed two-column grid meant a third item wrapped
  onto a second row that the 22px height then clipped, so the vim mode
  indicator pushed the status text out of view whenever it appeared.

## Install

Auto-updates from dev.53 and later. Otherwise unzip and run.
